title: Fasting
lead: Going without food, usually with prayer, mourning or repentance: Moses on the mountain (Exodus 34:28), the Day of Atonement's call to humble yourselves (Leviticus 16:29), David for his dying child (2 Samuel 12:16), Ezra at the Ahava River (Ezra 8:21–23), Esther before she went to the king (Esther 4:16), Nineveh (Jonah 3:5), Isaiah's true fast (Isaiah 58:3–7), Jesus in the wilderness (Matthew 4:2), his teaching to fast in secret (Matthew 6:16–18) and his saying that his disciples would fast once the bridegroom was taken away (Mark 2:18–20), and the church at Antioch fasting before it sent out Barnabas and Saul (Acts 13:2–3).
